create_LlamaEmbeddingModel: create a LlamaEmbeddingModel with a LlamaConfig and optional quant_config for text embeddings
run_LlamaEmbeddingModel_forward: run LlamaEmbeddingModel forward with input_ids, positions, and forward_batch to get embeddings
load_LlamaEmbeddingModel_weights: load LlamaEmbeddingModel weights from a list of named tensors with shard mapping support
create_MistralModel: create a MistralModel embedding model inheriting from LlamaEmbeddingModel
review_LlamaEmbeddingModel_load_weights: review LlamaEmbeddingModel load_weights for stacked parameter mapping and GPTQ bias skipping
